title: RelationQualifier
description: A truth-conditional dimension that may affect relation identity. A qualifier records a `dimension` (e.g. polarity, condition, scope, modality, participantRoles, or a profile-defined dimension such as jurisdiction or threshold) together with a `status`. CRITICAL RULES: (1) `status` is one of `specified`, `absent`, or `unknown`; (2) `unknown` MUST NOT be treated as equivalent to `absent`; (3) when `status` is `specified`, a normalized `value` MUST be present; (4) any identity-relevant qualifier whose status is `unknown` MUST block automatic relation merging. IDENTITY RELEVANCE IS NOT CARRIED HERE: whether a dimension participates in the identity key is a property of the dimension, declared once in `ProfileVocabulary.qualifierDimensions[].identityRelevant`, not a property of an occurrence. Carrying it on the instance too would admit an instance that contradicts its own vocabulary, with no principled winner; the vocabulary is the sole authority.

dimension.description: The qualifier dimension. Minimum recognized dimensions: polarity, condition, scope, modality, participantRoles. Profiles MAY add dimensions (jurisdiction, threshold, exception, population, dosage, territorialScope, authorityLevel, temporalRelation, ...).

status.description: Whether this dimension is specified, deliberately absent, or unknown. `unknown` is NOT the same as `absent`.

value.description: The normalized value of the dimension. REQUIRED when status is `specified`; MUST be omitted otherwise. May be a scalar or a structured value depending on the dimension.

note.description: Optional human-readable note explaining the qualifier or the reason it is unknown/absent.
